detail: The acceptance criterion is to repeat all the Steps to Reproduce. Step 5 opens My orders for the same newly placed order in an Asia/Tokyo browser, and TC-06 stops at step 4; TC-02 checks Tokyo only on a seeded order. Add to TC-06: open a second browser context with timezoneId 'Asia/Tokyo', sign in as alice, open My orders, and assert the order's Date equals the same instant (parsed from the Chicago text) formatted in Asia/Tokyo as MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss, including the calendar date.

The test captions 'after' and the UTC comparison and highlights the cell with 'not 11/16/2026 18:21:17 UTC', but frames 04, 06 and 07 show no caption or highlight label. Only 'before' and the local time 12:21:17 are visible, so the video never shows the not-UTC claim or the end of the time window. Highlight labels are missing in every case's frames, which points to the recording helper rather than this test.

The test records before/after and the UTC counterpart and narrates them through demo.caption, but none of the keyframes (04, 06, 07) show those captions. The video therefore can't show that 12:42:46 lies in the before..after window or what the UTC time would be. Frame 04 also shows checkout already redirected to /user/orders, so the user-menu 'My orders' click in step 5 navigates to the page already on screen. Keep the window/UTC caption on screen while the highlighted cell is captured.

The case requires opening My orders through the user menu with no full page load, to catch the date rewrite on a page reached by Blazor enhanced navigation. The test clicks the link, then calls page.reload() before reading the .order-date cell, so the assertions run on a fully loaded document. A fix that fails after enhanced navigation would still pass. Read the date before the reload, or drop it.

No highlight keyframe shows the demo.highlight outline or label (same in TC-01, -02, -04, -05 and -06). The frames keep the earlier 'Browser time zone ... opened /user/orders' caption, so per-row narration such as order 3's 'previous day' or TC-06's Tokyo '+15 h' label never appears in the video. The values are visible and correct.
